attempted_claim: Let (S^3, xi_st) = boundary(D^4, lambda_st). Does there exist an oriented Legendrian knot Lambda in (S^3, xi_st) bounding infinitely many embedded exact orientable Maslov-0 Lagrangian disks L_i in (D^4, lambda_st) such that all L_i are pairwise smoothly isotopic relative to Lambda but pairwise distinct up to compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopy (exact Lagrangian isotopy rel boundary)?
decisive_failure: The disk-finiteness question remains fully open: neither infinitude nor finiteness of Hamiltonian-distinct exact Maslov-0 disks in one smooth class is established, and the residual routes (tb=-1 infinite-order smoothly-trivial loops; a new disk-finiteness theorem) were identified but are beyond a bounded pass with the literature budget exhausted.
